def get_server_policies(session: requests.Session, policy_file:
    SafetyPolicyFile, proxy_dictionary: Dict[str, str]) ->tuple:
    server_policy = fetch_policy(session)
    
    safety_policy = server_policy.get("safety_policy", "")
    audit_and_monitor = server_policy.get("audit_and_monitor", False)
    
    if safety_policy and not policy_file:
        import tempfile
        import yaml
        
        try:
            policy_contents = safety_policy
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', suffix='.yml', delete=False) as f:
                f.write(policy_contents)
                tmp_policy_file = f.name
            
            from .util import SafetyPolicyFile as SPF
            policy_file = SPF(tmp_policy_file)
        except Exception:
            LOG.exception("Error processing server policy")
    
    return policy_file, audit_and_monitor
